title: Golden Yellow 63-Inch Extended 3-Post Grab Bar, Wall Mount Iron Pipe, Allied Brass
body_html:
Create a safer, more accessible bathroom without giving up bold, industrial style—backed by a limited lifetime warranty — available in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. This 63-inch extended grab bar from the Pipeline collection uses a 3-post design with a third center bracket for enhanced stability.

  • Golden Yellow adds style to a safety essential
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Count on a durable powder coat finish designed for corrosion-free, rust-free performance
  • Choose an ADA compliant grab bar that fits industrial bathroom hardware and modern utility spaces
  • Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Pipeline collection

Why it lasts: Iron pipe construction and a three-post mounting configuration are built for daily use and added stability.

Specs
- Product type: Grab bar (extended length, 3-post)
- Collection: Pipeline
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Material: Iron Pipe
- ADA compliant: Yes
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Dimensions (L x H x Projection): 63 in x 3 in x 3.58 in
- Product weight: 5 lb
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
meta_description: 63-inch ADA compliant wall-mount grab bar with 3-post stability. Iron pipe construction and powder coat finish. Pipeline collection. Limited lifetime warranty.
